W.intro1: You live in Pecan Grove. The Miller family wants to sell their old farm by the creek. A company wants to build a data center there. Learn 15 ways to be a helpful neighbor while your town decides.
W.intro2: There's no one right answer. You earn points for how well you listen, check facts and speak kindly.
W.grownText: Your game is saved on this device. Notes are sent only after you choose Send. Score sharing starts off. A grown-up can turn it on.
W.allStops: Choose a stop: names and progress
W.mapHelp: Town map. Use the arrow keys to scroll, or choose a stop from the list below.
W.journeyHelp: Your journey adds your best score at each stop. Replaying can improve it; a lower score never takes points away.
W.perfect: Perfect score saved! Try a new round to practice with different examples.
W.languageNote: You will keep your place in this stop.
W.noImproved: Play a stop again to earn Most improved!
W.everyone: Everyone gets better by playing again.
W.sure: Are you sure? This erases all scores on this device.
W.bothTeams: Great work, both teams! Play again and switch who goes first.
W.first: First score saved! Play again to beat it.
W.goodStart: Good start! Every round is practice.
W.tryReal: Try it for real (with a grown-up)
W.footer: Made with the help of AI tools. Voices made with ElevenLabs AI. Ideas from construction research at Kennesaw State University. v0.1

X.setSub: How the game sounds and looks. This device remembers it.
X.autoHint: When this is off, tap the speaker button at the end of a line to hear it.
X.words: Light up each word as it is read
X.capHint: Shows who is talking and what they say, at the bottom of the game.
X.circlesHint: When the voice says what to tap, a marker circle shows where it is.
X.calmSys: Your device asks for less motion, so this stays on.
X.keysNote: On a computer, these keys work while you play.
X.reset: Go back to the usual settings
X.resetDone: Settings are back to the usual.
X.librarySub: Set up this device for a classroom or a quiet library.
X.libraryNote: Quiet mode turns off narration and speaker buttons. All instructions stay on screen. This device remembers the sound setting.
X.libraryActive: Quiet mode is on. You can keep playing without sound.
X.libraryGroupsNote: Animal profiles and team scores belong to this player session. Use New player for a different person's private feedback.
